$description: ProductOptions (platform/components/ProductOptions), library wave 13, lane A: its component tokens. The space between the options and inside each; the option's name and chosen value (the label roles, as RadioTiles' legend); the size tiles' narrowest width; the swatches' gap and the dimmed out of stock swatch (opacity-mid, as a disabled tile); the error line on the field error's roles. The tiles, swatches and stepper keep their own components' tokens.

product-options-gap.$description: ProductOptions: the space between two options (space-stack-md).

product-options-option-gap.$description: ProductOptions: the space between an option's name, its choices and its error (space-stack-xs).

product-options-legend-text.$description: ProductOptions: the option's name (content-default, as RadioTiles' legend).

product-options-legend-font-family.$description: ProductOptions: the option's name in the label font (font-label).

product-options-legend-font-size.$description: ProductOptions: the option's name and chosen value (12px, as RadioTiles' legend).

product-options-legend-gap.$description: ProductOptions: the gap between the option's name and its chosen value (space-inline-xs).

product-options-label-font-weight.$description: ProductOptions: the option's name (semibold, as RadioTiles' legend).

product-options-chosen-text.$description: ProductOptions: the chosen value after the name (content-muted).

product-options-size-min.$description: ProductOptions: a size tile's narrowest width; the tiles share the row (64px).

product-options-swatch-gap.$description: ProductOptions: the gap between two color swatches (space-inline-sm).

product-options-unavailable-opacity.$description: ProductOptions: an out of stock swatch, dimmed (opacity-mid, as a disabled radio tile).

product-options-error-text.$description: ProductOptions: an option's error (feedback-danger-solid, as Field's error).

product-options-error-font-size.$description: ProductOptions: the error's size (11px, as Field's error).

product-options-error-gap.$description: ProductOptions: the gap between the error's icon and its words (space-inline-xs).
